title: Rig Relay SearchReplace Receipt v1
description: Content-light receipt for a search_replace invocation. Contains no raw file content, old_text, new_text, or diffs — only metadata, block counts, SHA256 hashes, byte counts, and structured error classification.

lines_changed.description: Number of lines changed in the file

before_file_sha256.description: Map of repo file key to sha256 hash of the file before editing

after_file_sha256.description: Map of repo file key to sha256 hash of the file after editing

changed_files.description: List of files that were changed

failed_block_count.description: Number of blocks that failed to match

total_block_count.description: Total number of blocks in the request

before_bytes.description: File size in bytes before editing

after_bytes.description: File size in bytes after editing

error_kind.description: Structured error classification when status is not success

refusal_reason.description: Human-readable reason when status is refused
